title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Mango Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Mango from Elfliq’s range of nic salt e-liquids is a mouth-watering tropical treat. The bright, sweet, sunny flavour of the freshest, juiciest mangoes makes for an endlessly uplifting and easy all-day vape that never fails to bring a little exotic sunshine to your day Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
